race.comment: HUBBLE'S DRAGON (5) was solid on resumption over this track and trip, racing in tougher company and only finishing 1.4L off the winner. Should be better for that effort and Fiore replaces the apprentice hoop. Won second-up last prep before placing in the Magic Millions. He ticks plenty of boxes. TRUE FICTION (4) scored in a photo last time out in easier company, flying late to score as the race favourite. Harvey remains on board and this shapes similarly. In good touch and can repeat the dose. FLASH DANCER (6) is looking for the hat-trick as he tackles Saturday grade. He's building a handy record as he works through the grades, winning narrowly here on the quick turnaround last start. Maps to get every chance and can extend his winning run. LORD SHIVA (1) should give himself every chance up front as he steps out in trip and back in grade. SHERPA EXPRESS (2) can improve on the fresh effort where he disappointed as an odds-on pop in this grade.
